rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the prehistoric animal.

example.english: I saw a dinosaur at the museum.
example.traditional: 我喺博物館見到一條恐龍。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 bok3 mat6 gun2 gin3 dou2 jat1 tiu4 hung2 lung4

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing that seems old-fashioned, rather than for a merely obsolete object.

example.english: My grandpa is such a dinosaur and still refuses to use a mobile phone.
example.traditional: 我阿爺係個老古董，仲唔肯用手機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 je4 hai6 go3 lou5 gu2 dung2 zung6 m4 hang2 jung6 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this specifically for an old-fashioned person who stubbornly refuses to change, rather than a general old-fashioned person or thing.

example.english: My uncle is a dinosaur and refuses to switch to electronic payments.
example.traditional: 我叔叔係個老頑固，點講都唔肯轉用電子支付。
example.jyutping: ngo5 suk1 suk1 hai6 go3 lou5 waan4 gu3 dim2 gong2 dou1 m4 hang2 zyun2 jung6 din6 zi2 zi1 fu6

rows.note: Use this for an outdated thing or practice that is no longer commonly used.

example.english: This fax machine is a dinosaur now.
example.traditional: 呢部傳真機已經係過時嘢喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 cyun4 zan1 gei1 ji5 ging1 hai6 gwo3 si4 je5 laa3
